name: Zodiacs.org historical time atlas: United States and France, 1870-1919

coverage.note: Civil time from 1 January 1870 to the end of 1919, read on each place's own clock. See atlas/COVERAGE.md for the places and what is left out.

longitudeSource.attribution: Place names, coordinates and GeoNames ids from GeoNames (https://www.geonames.org/).
longitudeSource.changes: For each covered place the atlas keeps only the GeoNames id, name, country code, latitude and longitude, copied unchanged (decimal degrees as published), and the name of its first-level administrative division from admin1CodesASCII.txt (https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/admin1CodesASCII.txt, retrieved 2026-09-28, SHA-256 1da92a6323a5fec3176f3f743bf4cf4040fd56a876da55e46fbca23c863aa60a). Nothing else from either file is redistributed.
